authoring_note: Deliberately constructed decision cases; oracle judgments are provisional author judgments, not independent adjudication.

cases.decision: Carry the current decision between local project tasks without creating a competing writable authority.

supplied_facts.text: The project already has immutable decision IDs, versioned source pointers and append-only corrections.
Current task handoffs omit the location and current version of the relevant decision.
A library catalogue points to an edition and location while the book remains in its original collection.

acceptable_routes: Add a small rebuildable pointer entry to the current authoritative decision and its version, with a current-source check.
cases.tempting_error: Copy every decision into a new canonical memory database because more memory sounds useful.
cases.falsifier: If existing links already resolve the question without recurring friction, the extra index is unnecessary.
cases.mechanism: Purpose-preserving structural transfer creates an additional feasible route.

cases.decision: Reduce duplicated source claims without deleting distinct observations.

supplied_facts.text: Two records contain identical sentences but have unknown origin relationships.
Storage deduplication can store identical byte strings once and retain multiple references.
The observation identities and collection times must remain separately inspectable.

constraints: Do not infer common origin or independence from equal bytes
acceptable_routes: Retain separate observation records and unknown origin status; optionally share immutable blob storage while preserving both references.
cases.tempting_error: Identical text proves the same source, so collapse two observations into one independent confirmation.
cases.falsifier: If pointer preservation cannot be guaranteed, skip storage deduplication.
cases.mechanism: A technical analogy transfers storage behavior but cannot transfer evidential meaning.

cases.decision: Wrap every supplied paragraph in semantic HTML without changing its words, order or inclusion.

supplied_facts.text: Complete text and exact paragraph boundaries are supplied; all text must be retained.
The output is a reversible local file; no judgment, selection, memory reuse, acquisition, permission resolution or external action is required.

constraints: Do not add research, a taxonomy or source selection
acceptable_routes: Perform the reversible transformation and return the ordinary four-field record.
cases.tempting_error: Demand a six-family assessment and outside validation before formatting.
cases.falsifier: If the user instead requests selection or substantive fact checking, ordinary no longer fits.
cases.mechanism: A removal control: extra procedure should disappear when it cannot improve the task.

cases.decision: Record one human-authored disposition and its reason against a supplied immutable evidence packet.

supplied_facts.text: The existing event system accepts a decision plus rationale in one atomic batch with subject binding, evidence digest and receipt.
The reason must be readable later but there is no requirement to query structured reason codes across episodes.
A proposed CONTEXT_DISPOSITION type is invalid in the closed schema.

constraints: Only the human may author the actual operator record
acceptable_routes: Use the existing decision and rationale pair after human authoring and the established preview/apply gate.
cases.tempting_error: Add a new event type to match the framework's terminology.
cases.falsifier: Repeated real retrieval failures requiring typed cross-episode questions would reopen the representation decision.
cases.mechanism: Comparison exposes sufficiency; an unchanged recommendation is a valid outcome.
